input.description: Extract a reusable native-fidelity Google Slides design system from a source presentation without mutating it. Captures masters, layouts, placeholders, theme tokens, and exemplar archetypes; stores large immutable artifacts privately and returns a bounded summary. FULL GUIDANCE: Call with the template's presentation_id — extraction precedes everything (the registry_key binds creation and validates every recommendation). Reuse a cache hit for an unchanged template. Retain the EXACT registry_key — never a snapshot hash or raw response. Treat source_presentation_id + registry_key + snapshot identity as indivisible; never mix snapshots in one destination. Pass the source ONLY to extraction/design-system tools — never load its slide library. Keep the response compact. Key gotchas: Reuse a cache hit for an unchanged template; do not force extraction merely to refresh it." (template-skill) | Retain the exact active `registry_key`. Never substitute a snapshot hash or the full extraction response." / "Use the same `source_presentation_id`, `registry_key`, and returned snapshot identity together throughout creation." (template-skill) | Speaker notes: "The tool reads each source slide's speaker notes into the private immutable manifest; it does not return the complete raw note library in the compact extraction response." (template-skill)
